title: Share lab monitoring steering and labeling across remote and embedded modes
description:
As a publication operator, I want the same UI for either supported deployment mode.

Feature: Share lab monitoring steering and labeling across remote and embedded modes
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given a central lab with multiple publication outputs or an embedded deployment-local engine
    When I monitor, steer and label an authorized publication
    Then the same shared controls operate on the selected authorized output and never mix another publication’s state

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Use the same shared monitoring/steering/labeling/PrimingPanel UI for the remote central multi-publication lab and embedded deployment-local mode. PR25 source is merged develop; application-hosted parity is not proven.

Feature: Mode-independent priming behavior
  Scenario: Repeat a saved example in either mode
    Given equivalent authorized fixtures in embedded and remote deployments
    When the same URL is curated, publish/reject selected, optional explanation saved and the page reloaded
    Then the same controls and persistence semantics apply
    And the selected output consumes only its accepted example IDs without cross-publication leakage

Dependencies: Papyrus PPY-58f107 and PPY-a8471b; Cyclotron package/release1019e003 and storageb5f1a414. Preserve shared component ownership; no separate UI fork.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.
